history_civics.medium: painterly editorial illustration, like a high-end documentary graphic novel
history_civics.palette: warm muted earth tones (ochre, umber, faded teal) with one saturated accent colour
history_civics.lighting: soft low golden light, gentle haze
history_civics.lens: 35mm cinematic framing, shallow depth of field
history_civics.era_note: period-accurate clothing, architecture and objects for the era in the narration; no modern items

biology.medium: clean scientific illustration, like a modern textbook cutaway with soft shading
biology.palette: oxygenated structures in warm red, deoxygenated in blue, tissue in soft cream and pink, neutral light background
biology.lighting: even soft studio light, subtle rim light
biology.lens: orthographic or slight three-quarter view, centred subject
biology.era_note: anatomically plausible and simple; no gore, no clutter

default.palette: muted palette with one accent colour

style_template: Style for the whole video (keep identical in every image): {medium}. Palette: {palette}. Lighting: {lighting}. Camera: {lens}. {era_note} Vertical 9:16 composition with the main subject large and centred in the middle 60 percent of the frame, the top fifth and bottom fifth calm and uncluttered.
negative: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, captions, signs with writing, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real-person likeness or celebrity faces. No extra fingers or limbs, no distorted faces, no modern objects in historical scenes. Do not depict any recognisable real person; faces must be generic and not resemble any public figure.
judge_prompt: You review one generated still for a short educational video. Narration for this moment: "{narration}". The picture was requested as: "{prompt}". Score 0-10 how well it shows what the narration needs, as a clean, correct, usable image. Deduct heavily for: any visible text, letters or numbers; garbled or extra hands, fingers, limbs or faces; anachronisms (modern objects in a historical scene); wrong anatomy for biology; a subject that does not match the request; any face that looks like a specific real, recognisable person (a politician, celebrity or historical figure), which must score 3 or lower; a cluttered or off-centre composition. Reply with JSON only: {"score": 0-10, "issues": ["short issue"]}
consistency_prompt: This image is a contact sheet of the stills of ONE short video, in order. Judge ONLY the visual style: same medium (painting or illustration versus photo-real), palette, lighting and level of detail. Ignore differences in subject, place, time of day or indoor versus outdoor, because the story moves between scenes. Score 0-10 how consistent the style is. Reply with JSON only: {"score": 0-10, "issues": ["short issue"]}

clips.prompt: Animate this exact image as realistic footage. Camera: {camera}. Motion: {motion}. Keep every subject, the setting, the lighting and the style exactly as in the image. No text, captions, letters or logos appear. No faces become close-ups. Natural, slow, gentle movement. No cuts.
